20: name = _t"Following The Way"
21: desc = function(self, who)
22: 	local desc = {}
23: 	desc[#desc+1] = _t"You have been tasked to remove at least one of the threats to the yeeks.\n"
24: 	desc[#desc+1] = _t"Protect the Way, and vanquish your foes.\n"
25: 	if self:isCompleted("murgol") then
26: 		if self:isCompleted("murgol-invaded") then
27: 			desc[#desc+1] = _t"#LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the underwater zone and vanquished the naga invader, Lady Nashva.#WHITE#"
28: 		else
29: 			desc[#desc+1] = _t"#LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the underwater zone and vanquished Murgol.#WHITE#"
30: 		end
31: 	else
32: 		desc[#desc+1] = _t"#SLATE#* You must explore the underwater lair of Murgol.#WHITE#"
33: 	end
34: 	if self:isCompleted("ritch") then
35: 		desc[#desc+1] = _t"#LIGHT_GREEN#* You have explored the ritch tunnels and vanquished their queen.#WHITE#"
36: 	else
37: 		desc[#desc+1] = _t"#SLATE#* You must explore the ritch tunnels.#WHITE#"
38: 	end
39: 	return table.concat(desc, "\n")
40: end

2669: newEffect{
2670: 	name = "ARCANE_VORTEX", image = "talents/arcane_vortex.png",
2671: 	desc = _t"Arcane Vortex",
2672: 	long_desc = function(self, eff) return ("An arcane vortex follows the target. Each turn a manathrust fires from it to a random foe in sight doing %0.2f arcane damage to all. If no foes are found the main target takes 50%% more arcane damage this turn. If the target dies the remaining damage is dealt as a radius 2 ball of arcane."):tformat(eff.dam) end,
2673: 	type = "magical",
2674: 	subtype = { arcane=true },
2675: 	status = "detrimental",
2676: 	parameters = { dam=10 },
2677: 	on_gain = function(self, err) return _t"#Target# is focused by an arcane vortex!", _t"+Arcane Vortex" end,
2678: 	on_lose = function(self, err) return _t"#Target# is free from the arcane vortex.", _t"-Arcane Vortex" end,
2679: 	on_timeout = function(self, eff)
2680: 		if not self.x then return end
2681: 		local l = {}
2682: 		self:project({type="ball", x=self.x, y=self.y, radius=7, selffire=false}, self.x, self.y, function(px, py)
2683: 			local target = game.level.map(px, py, Map.ACTOR)
2684: 			if target and target ~= self and eff.src:reactionToward(target) < 0 then l[#l+1] = target end
2685: 		end)
2686: 
2687: 		if #l == 0 then
2688: 			DamageType:get(DamageType.ARCANE).projector(eff.src, self.x, self.y, DamageType.ARCANE, eff.dam * 1.5)
2689: 		else
2690: 			DamageType:get(DamageType.ARCANE).projector(eff.src, self.x, self.y, DamageType.ARCANE, eff.dam)
2691: 			local act = rng.table(l)
2692: 			eff.src:project({type="beam", x=self.x, y=self.y}, act.x, act.y, DamageType.ARCANE, eff.dam, nil)
2693: 			game.level.map:particleEmitter(self.x, self.y, math.max(math.abs(act.x-self.x), math.abs(act.y-self.y)), "mana_beam", {tx=act.x-self.x, ty=act.y-self.y})
2694: 		end
2695: 
2696: 		game:playSoundNear(self, "talents/arcane")
2697: 	end,
2698: 	on_die = function(self, eff)
2699: 		local tg = {type="ball", radius=2, selffire=false, x=self.x, y=self.y}
2700: 		eff.src:project(tg, self.x, self.y, DamageType.ARCANE, eff.dam * eff.dur)
2701: 		if core.shader.active(4) then
2702: 			game.level.map:particleEmitter(self.x, self.y, 2, "shader_ring", {radius=4, life=12}, {type="sparks", zoom=1, time_factor=400, hide_center=0, color1={0.6, 0.3, 0.8, 1}, color2={0.8, 0, 0.8, 1}})
